records.name: Decihertz gravitational-wave sensitivity
records.meaning: Poor present sensitivity between major space- and ground-based concepts; not a physical existence gap.

records.name: Ultra-high-frequency gravitational-wave coverage
records.meaning: Experimental sensitivity is sparse compared with established ground-based bands.

records.name: Dark-matter candidate parameter space
records.meaning: Large portions of candidate parameter space remain model-dependent and incompletely constrained.

records.name: Dynamical dark-energy interpretation
records.meaning: Current datasets do not establish evolving dark energy; competing models remain under comparison.

records.name: Quantum nature of gravity
records.meaning: No experimentally established quantum theory of gravity or universally decisive test.

records.name: Black-hole interior / singularity resolution
records.meaning: Classical singularity prediction lacks a confirmed quantum-gravity completion.

records.name: Natural wormhole existence
records.meaning: Wormholes are theoretical and unobserved; realizability and signatures are model-dependent.

records.name: Physical mechanism sufficient for consciousness
records.meaning: Competing theories make different claims; no single mechanism is established.

records.name: Terminal/paradoxical lucidity mechanism
records.scope: severe neurological impairment / end of life
records.meaning: Phenomenology is reported but prospective physiological mechanism remains incomplete.

records.name: Near-death experience mechanism
records.meaning: Reported experiences are studied; mechanism and interpretation remain unresolved.

records.name: Anomalous cognition / telepathy
records.meaning: Literature is heterogeneous and lacks an established reproducible physical carrier.

records.name: Physically interacting soul
records.meaning: No measurable state variable, carrier, coupling, or falsification condition is established.

records.name: Postmortem personal survival carrier
records.meaning: No reproducible information-bearing substrate independent of irreversible brain failure is established.

records.name: Energy carrier for anomalous-information claims
records.meaning: Information transfer is claimed in some studies, but no novel energy transfer or carrier is established.

records.name: Established-spectrum catalog is representative, not exhaustive
records.meaning: Many material-, species-, branch-, and object-specific modes/lines remain to be cataloged; absence from the atlas is not physical absence.

records.name: Blank frequency interval
records.meaning: A blank visual region has no scientific significance unless tied to a family, model, observable, and measurement coverage.
